{{short description|Taiwanese physicist}}
[[File:Din Ping Tsai.jpg|thumb|Prof. Din Ping Tsai at the NANOP 2019 conference]]

'''Din Ping Tsai''' ({{lang-zh|t=蔡定平|p=Cài Dìngpíng}}; born c. 1959) is a physicist known for his work in the fields of [[photonics]]. He is currently a Distinguished Professor at the [[National Taiwan University]] and Director of the Research Center for Applied Sciences, [[Academia Sinica]]. He has been President of Taiwan Information Storage Association (TISA) since 2015.

Tsai obtained his Ph.D. in physics from the [[University of Cincinnati]] in 1990, and subsequently worked as a researcher in California, Toronto and Taiwan.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://dptsai.com/prof.htm|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170116120608/http://dptsai.com/prof.htm|url-status=usurped|archive-date=January 16, 2017|title=Din Ping Tsai|website=Phototonics / Nano-Science & Technology Laboratory|access-date=19 April 2017}}</ref> He became an associate professor at the National Taiwan University in 1999 and was Director General of the Instrument Technology Research Center (NARL) in [[Hsinchu]], Taiwan between 2008 and 2012.

== Awards and honours ==
* '''[[SPIE]] Mozi Award''', 2018 "in recognition of his eminent contributions to the optical Meta-lens and Metadevice"<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mozi Award - SPIE|url=https://spie.org/about-spie/awards-programs/awards-listing/spie-mozi-award|access-date=2020-09-01|website=spie.org}}</ref>
* '''Fellow,''' [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]] (AAAS), 2016. ''"For distinguished contributions in nano optics and nanophotonics."''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/2016-fellows|title=2016 Fellows}}</ref>
* '''Fellow''', International Society for Nano Manipulation, Manufacturing and Measurement (3M NANO), 2014. "''For outstanding professional achievement in nano science and engineering."''
* '''Fellow''', [[Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers]] (IEEE), 2012. "''For contributions to nanophotonics and near-field optics for microscopy and storage."''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ieee.org/documents/fellows_class_2012.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120215201114/http://www.ieee.org/documents/fellows_class_2012.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=February 15, 2012|title=2012 elevated fellow|website=IEEE Fellows Directory}}</ref>
* '''Fellow''', [[:zh:国际电磁科学院|Electromagnetics Academy (EMA)]], 2007.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://emacademy.org/TEA/fema.php?id=000001998|title=Who's Who in Electromagnetics}}</ref>
* '''Fellow,''' [[American Physical Society]] (APS), 2007. ''"For his contributions in nanophotonics, plasmonics, and near-field optics especially on near-field scaning optical microscopy, nano storage and nano imaging."''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=T&year=2007&unit_id=&institution=|title=APS Fellow Archive}}</ref>
* '''Fellow''', Physical Society of R. O. C., 2006.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.psroc.org.tw/award.php?id=25&fid=4&aid=6|title=物理學會歷屆會士|access-date=2017-09-28|archive-date=2017-09-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170928103450/http://www.psroc.org.tw/award.php?id=25&fid=4&aid=6|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* '''Fellow''', [[The Optical Society|Optical Society of America]] (OSA), 2006. ''"For specific achievements in the areas of near-field optics and nano-photonics, nano optical imaging and storage, and near-field optical storage."''<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.osa.org/en-us/awards_and_grants/fellow_members/recent_fellows/2006_fellows/|title=2006 OSA Fellows}}</ref>
* '''Fellow''', [[SPIE|International Society of Optical Engineering (SPIE)]], 2005. ''"For achievements in the areas of near-field optics and nanophotonics."''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://spie.org/about-spie/fellows-and-senior-members/fellows/complete-list-of-spie-fellows?SSO=1|title=Complete List of SPIE Fellows}}</ref>
* '''Corresponding Member''', [[Russian Academy of Engineering|International Academy of Engineering]], 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://info-iae.ru/en/members/members-of-iae-2/taiwan-chapter-of-the-international-academy-of-engineering/|title=Taiwan Chapter of the International Academy of Engineering}}</ref>
* '''Academician''', Asia Pacific Academy of Materials (APAM), 2013.
